local_structure.interpretation: The exact phase system has no low-rank, component, sharing, or low-separator structure for a compact dynamic program.

screened_families.family: root LP rounding, feasibility pump, or MIP start
screened_families.reason: binary-only exact-phase MIP starts, deterministic rounding of persistent-LP candidates, complete constructive starts, second phase projection, and fixed-cell LP variants are already closed by formal capability or concurrency gates

screened_families.family: Reluplex, DPLL(T), SAT phase learning, or exact star enumeration
screened_families.reason: completeness requires ReLU case splits or activation-region enumeration, which is the forbidden combinatorial search under a different name

screened_families.family: multi-neuron LP, SDP, or completely-positive formulation
screened_families.reason: tractable variants are convex relaxations; the exact completely-positive program retains NP-hard membership and introduces a dense lifted matrix whose quadratic storage is incompatible with the current full forward graph and latency budget

screened_families.family: mixed complementarity or semismooth local solve
screened_families.reason: the signed residual network is a general nonmonotone complementarity problem with no complete root-only pivot guarantee; a local numerical solve would be another nonauthoritative search path and a custom backend

screened_families.family: additional corner, line, plane, hinge, neighbor, or property selector
screened_families.reason: the fixed formal endpoints and global affine structure census already close these single-cell selection families on the first official UNKNOWN capability target

direct_first_cell_analytic_corner_withou.rule: reuse the verifier-derived first-cell analytic corner as the candidate in the updated exact cell and retain all phase, margin, BOX, and singleton replay

impossible_zero_cost_support_lp_and_sing.remaining_work: two generator streams, selected affine matrix construction, exact phase and margin replay, and host/device orchestration
impossible_zero_cost_support_lp_and_sing.decision: all identified local optimizations are jointly closed; a promotable path must remove a complete generator stream or replace the representation itself

decision: Do not implement a feasibility-pump wrapper, fifth solver encoding, complementarity backend, or relaxation path.
